answer: Require every agent to stake a bond behind a cedar-signed identity, like planting a cedar whose roots cost real time and funds to grow. Newcomers start at the base, not the summit: they must complete small paid tasks and earn peer attestations before handling larger value. A beacon service publishes each agent's reputation and stake history, so a flood of fake identities is instantly visible and expensive — an attacker must fund a bond, build history, and pass verification for every clone, while one exposed identity burns the whole stake.
